title: Set a topic or identify a subject

variants.label: は · topic

segments.role: は sets me as the topic and says something about me. It can also create a contrast.

example.translation: As for me, I am a student.
example.note: Answering a general question about yourself.

variants.change: は sets me as the topic and says something about me. It can also create a contrast.

variants.label: が · identification

segments.role: が identifies me as the relevant subject. The focus depends on the question and context; this is not a universal replacement rule.

example.translation: I am the one who is a student.

variants.change: が identifies me as the relevant subject. The focus depends on the question and context; this is not a universal replacement rule.

question: Someone asks which person is the student. Which response most directly identifies the person?
feedback: In this identification context, が focuses on the person who fits. は is useful for introducing or contrasting a topic.
